outside_policy: Only these wrapper protocol fields move into reversible sidecar. All scientific_record fields, case, question, coverage, source_ref, source_scope, bounds and other fields stay visible. Hashes inside scientific fields or source_ref stay visible. No clinical/source field is interpreted or corrected. Original full request retained at its original pinned location.
dedup_policy: Only identical strings exposed by quote_choices, at least 64 UTF8 bytes, occurring at least twice among original eligible quote pointers. Replace each occurrence with a tagged SHA256 reference; render a dictionary with full original strings once and all original alias/pointer occurrences. No clipping, arbitrary string interning, scientific field removal, or duplicate independence claim.
roundtrip: Reinflate each reference and restore exact protocol sidecar paths; canonical reconstructed request must exactly equal original bytes. Fail on collision, absent path or unexpected original tag.
schedule: All six PLAN-v2 stages and worst prior source-ID history; same 6368 prompt-byte,32000 aggregate input,8000 output,1024 per-stage output limits;32 reservation per stage. No native/model admission.
guide_policy: Single short guide retaining status semantics, exact source_report vs authored inference separation, no external knowledge, quote pairs, limits; claim cap derived from original bounds. No alternative guide/representation search after results.
stop_rule: Measure once all three fixed inputs. If real input does not fit, retain negative and stop; no budget increase, source rewrite, easier replacement, or stage removal.
